facts.locator: The city east-exit public pedestrian guide page 3 explicitly leads from Nagasaki Station Kamome Exit along the long-roof passage to the operating traffic-plaza bus boarding area. Its August-September 2026 current construction update page 1 confirms this plaza remains operational, separately from the unopened national-road bus bay. The operator current boarding diagram component 3 identifies its traffic-plaza stop, matching the licensed GTFS exact point 881010_06. Use the existing admitted Shinkansen station component and exact bus stop, with no same-name or parent-station collapse. No walking time, step-free guarantee, or transfer to other bus bays is asserted.
